title: Meet the Masters
description: Introduce yourself to Tamsin Deepholt, the Mining Master.

giver.name: Hollis Barrowmead
giver.text: Now the good part: the Masters. Five trades keep Skyhaven fed and armed: mining, foraging, farming, fishing and combat. Each has a master who'll teach you, sell you tools and, if you're polite, give you a starter kit.
